fitAnalysis.assessment:
Your 22% match is a WEAK FIT for this Experiential Marketing Associate role.

**Strengths:**
- Social Media Lead for three years (Westbrook Film Society)
- Canva and CapCut skills for creative materials
- Google Analytics for Beginners certification and Instagram Insights reporting

**Gaps:**
- No event management or experiential marketing experience (2+ years required)
- No vendor, venue, contract or budget management experience
- No Splash, Eventbrite, Cvent, Asana or Monday.com experience

**Recommendation:** Build event experience first through volunteer or campus event coordination, learn Eventbrite and Asana, then apply to junior event roles.

coverLetter:
Maya Linden
Portland, OR, USA
maya.linden@example.com
+1 555 0142

October 12, 2026

Hiring Manager
Coinbase

Dear Hiring Manager,

Your events have to make Coinbase feel real to Consumer and Institutional audiences alike, and that only works when every detail of the lifecycle is handled, from concept to post-event reporting. I've seen how much a single event can move people. At Harbor Street Pet Supply, I helped plan a weekend adoption event that brought in about 300 visitors.

I'm early in my career, so I won't claim the 2+ years of event experience you list. What I can offer is hands-on groundwork and the habit of measuring results. As a Marketing Intern, I supported that event alongside the weekly posts and newsletter. As Social Media Lead for the Westbrook Film Society, I raised average screening ticket sales from 35 to 60 per event, and I trained two new volunteers along the way. I track results in Google Analytics (basic), Instagram Insights and Excel, which is the foundation I'd build on for the attendance data, engagement metrics and attribution your post-event reports call for. Serving up to 150 customers per shift as a barista taught me to stay calm and keep quality up when things overlap.

I'd like to bring that energy to your experiential marketing calendar and learn your event tools and vendor processes quickly. I'm available to start whenever suits your team and would welcome a conversation about the role.

Kind regards,
Maya Linden

applicationEmail.subject: Application: Experiential Marketing Associate, Maya Linden
applicationEmail.body:
Hello Coinbase Events Team,

At Harbor Street Pet Supply I helped plan a weekend adoption event that brought about 300 visitors through the door, and I'd like to bring that hands-on energy to your experiential calendar. I've also coordinated with volunteers and colleagues, including training two new volunteers on the Westbrook Film Society's social channels and four new colleagues at Corner Bean Cafe, so working across a team to hit a date is familiar to me. My CV and cover letter are attached for you to look through. I'm available for a call any weekday this month and can start as soon as needed.

Best regards,
Maya Linden
